connector.name: Ai Brand Visibility Tracker
connector.registryDescription: Check if ChatGPT, Perplexity & Gemini mention or cite a brand. Share of voice + GEO/AEO tracking.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.apify.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cookient16 account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Apify API token, format: 'Bearer <apify-api-token>'. Get a free token at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations
